page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number at top left. Full-width heading below it. Centred table of numbers in four columns with a header row, followed by a closing row "Radix." Then running text at full width, ending in a hyphenated word. A marginal note in the left margin beside the last lines.

main_text.head: Cycli decennouennales in denarios & centenarios distributi.
main_text.p: Harum epactarum demonstrationes attuli in commentario ad Alfraganum adiecto: vt non opus sit eas repetere. Ad praxin accedamus: datur annus mundi 5340, cuius characterem hebdomadicum scire deside-Characteres feriarum quomodo in

page.notes: Marginal note in the left margin reads "Characteres feriarum quomodo in", set in italic, beside the last lines of text. The table is printed centred; the header "Num. cyclor." is two lines. The line "Radix." is italic. Scan shows show-through from the reverse page, not transcribed. The final word "deside-" is hyphenated and continues on the next page.
